module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Common functionality for checking if presence/absence of empty lines

      module EmptyLinesAroundBody
        extend NodePattern::Macros
        include ConfigurableEnforcedStyle

        end

        def check_line(style, line, msg, &block)
          EmptyLinesAroundMethodBody.coordinator_for(self).inspect_body_line(style, line, msg, &block)
        end
      end
    end
  end

part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `Layout/EmptyLinesAroundMethodBody#on_def` (lib/rubocop/cop/layout/empty_lines_around_method_body.rb:30): when a method's arguments span multiple lines, the "beginning of body" boundary was still computed from the `def` keyword line, so the blank line after the closing `)` was never inspected.

The fix passes the closing-paren line as `adjusted_first_line` (the same mechanism already used by the class/block body cops) whenever the parameter list is on a line other than the `def` keyword line:

```ruby
def on_def(node)
  check(node, node.body, adjusted_first_line: adjusted_body_first_line(node))
end
alias on_defs on_def

def adjusted_body_first_line(node)
  arguments_end_line = node.arguments.loc.end&.line
  return if arguments_end_line.nil? || arguments_end_line == node.source_range.first_line

  arguments_end_line
end
```
